        content.innerHTML = renderPerformanceNotes() + renderedHtml;
        restoreExpandedDetails();
        expandSearchMatches();
        bindDetailsToggleEvents();
        bindNodeActionEvents();
        bindFilterEvents();
        bindTreeMenuEvents();
        bindColumnResizeEvents();
        bindColumnFreezeEvents();
        applyFrozenLayout();
        bindCopyEvents();
        bindStickyContextEvents();
        updateStickyOffsets();
        updateStickyContextBar();
        updateSettingsPanel();
        renderFilterChips();
        bindSettingsPanelEvents();

        if (!tableRows) {
          setMeta("树形表格 · " + renderMetaPath(tablePath));
        }
      } else {
        meta.textContent = "原始 JSON";
        filterChips.classList.remove("active");
        filterChips.innerHTML = "";
        content.classList.remove("freeze-header");
        hideStickyContextBar();
        content.innerHTML = "<pre></pre>";
        content.querySelector("pre").textContent = JSON.stringify(json, null, 2);
      }

      toggle.textContent = showTable ? "原始" : "表格";
      showTypeCheck.checked = showTypeColumn;
    }
    
    pathSelect.onchange = function () {
      setRootPath(pathSelect.value);
    };

    globalSearch.oninput = function () {
      closeTreeMenu();
      render();
    };

    resetFilters.onclick = function () {
      columnFilters = {};
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      globalSearch.value = "";
      render();
    };

    pathUp.onclick = function () {
      setRootPath(parentPath(selectedPath));
    };

    copyPathBtn.onclick = function () {
      copyText(tablePath);
    };

    copyJsonBtn.onclick = function () {
      copyText(JSON.stringify(getExportRows(), null, 2));
    };

    exportJsonBtn.onclick = function () {
      downloadFile("json-table-export.json", JSON.stringify(getExportRows(), null, 2), "application/json");
    };

    exportCsvBtn.onclick = function () {
      // L7: frozen columns are shown front-and-center in the grid, but the
      // export keeps the data's original column order. Tell the user so the
      // reordering isn't mistaken for a data change.
      var fz = getFrozenColumns(tablePath);
      var fzCount = fz ? Object.keys(fz).filter(function (k) { return fz[k]; }).length : 0;
      if (fzCount) {
        showToast("导出列顺序为数据原始顺序（冻结列在表格中前置显示，不影响导出内容）");
      }
      downloadFile("json-table-export.csv", rowsToCsv(getExportRows(), currentColumns.length ? currentColumns : currentAllColumns), "text/csv;charset=utf-8");
    };

    favPathBtn.onclick = function () {
      toggleFavoritePath(selectedPath);
    };

    settingsBtn.onclick = function (event) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      settingsMenu.hidden = !settingsMenu.hidden;
      settingsBtn.classList.toggle("active", !settingsMenu.hidden);
      settingsBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!settingsMenu.hidden));
    };

    showTypeCheck.onchange = function () {
      showTypeColumn = showTypeCheck.checked;
      savePersistedState();
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      render();
    };

    freezeHeaderCheck.onchange = function () {
      freezeHeader = freezeHeaderCheck.checked;
      savePersistedState();
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      render();
    };

    showStickyHeaderCheck.onchange = function () {
      showStickyHeader = showStickyHeaderCheck.checked;
      savePersistedState();
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      hideStickyTableHead();
      updateStickyContextBar();
    };

    parseJsonStringCheck.onchange = function () {
      parseJsonString = parseJsonStringCheck.checked;
      savePersistedState();
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      render();
    };

    headerModeSelect.onchange = function () {
      stickyHeaderMode = headerModeSelect.value === "multi" ? "multi" : "single";
      savePersistedState();
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      hideStickyTableHead();
      updateStickyContextBar();
    };

    toggle.onclick = function () {
      showTable = !showTable;
      activeFilterColumn = null;
      closeTreeMenu();
      render();
    };

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var target = event.target;
      var inTreeLayer = target && target.closest &&
        (target.closest(".tree-menu") || target.closest(".tree-menu-btn"));
      var inFilterLayer = target && target.closest &&
        (target.closest(".th-wrap") || target.closest(".filter-menu") || target.closest(".filter-btn"));
      var inSettingsLayer = settingsWrap && settingsWrap.contains(target);

      if (!inSettingsLayer) {
        settingsMenu.hidden = true;
        settingsBtn.classList.remove("active");
        settingsBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      if (treeMenuOpen && !inTreeLayer) {
        closeTreeMenu();
      }

      if (activeFilterColumn && !inFilterLayer) {
        activeFilterColumn = null;
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.body.querySelectorAll(".filter-menu"), function (menu) {
          if (menu.parentNode) menu.parentNode.removeChild(menu);
        });
      }
    });

    bindStickyContextEvents();
    render();
  });
</script>
